definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese confection made from red bean paste, agar, and sugar. Has a firm, jelly-like texture and is typically served in slices.

notes:
{羊羹|ようかん} is a classic Japanese confection.

Types:
- ⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧{羊羹|ようかん} (firm yokan) - most common
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧{羊羹|ようかん} (soft/water yokan) - summer treat
- ⟦{蒸|む}し→蒸す：02307_musu⟧{羊羹|ようかん} (steamed yokan)
- ⟦{芋|いも}→芋：10231_imo⟧{羊羹|ようかん} (sweet potato yokan)
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧{羊羹|ようかん} (chestnut yokan)

Ingredients:
- ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧ (red bean paste)
- ⟦{寒天|かんてん}→寒天：12463_kanten⟧ (agar)
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar)

Characteristics:
- Long shelf life (especially ⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧{羊羹|ようかん})
- Dense, sweet, satisfying
- Pairs well with green tea
- Often a formal gift

Famous brand: ⟦{虎屋|とらや}→虎屋：noentry⟧ (Toraya) - over 500 years old
